_note: Every sound in the game, by moment (the key the code asks for, `area.event`; code never names a file). name = the moment in a few words, as the Credits screen lists it. game/sound_director.gd plays them; docs/SOUND_SPEC.md is the handover guide. files = the variants under audio/, one picked at random each time (named <area>_<event>_<nn>.ogg, made with tools/import_sound.sh). bus = the mixer bus it plays on (default_bus_layout.tres: Music, Ambience, World, UI, Stingers, each with a volume slider in Settings once it has sounds). tier = the emphasis tier from docs/TEXT_STYLE.md (0 ambient, 1 notice, 2 problem, 3 moment, 4 run): louder and rarer as it rises. volume_db = how loud this moment plays (files are all peak-levelled to -1 dBFS, so this alone sets it). pitch_jitter = how far each play's pitch may wander either way (0.05 = 5%), so repeats don't sound stamped. max_voices = how many of this moment may sound at once; a new one past that is skipped. cooldown_s = a repeat sooner than this is skipped. brief = what the moment should feel like, for whoever redoes the sound: keep the intent, change the sound. licence = one line per source (author, where from, licence); the credits screen is built from these. Only CC0 and CC-BY sounds go in (the repo is public; no NC, ND or SA).

ui.click.name: button click
ui.click.brief: Any button pressed: a small dry tick, felt more than heard. Never bright or electronic in a way that breaks the grit.

ui.hover.name: card hover
ui.hover.brief: The mouse comes to rest on a card: the faintest touch, so sweeping across a hand isn't a rattle.

ui.toggle.name: setting switch
ui.toggle.brief: A setting switched or chosen from a list: a soft latch.

card.deal.name: cards dealt
card.deal.brief: Cards laid out for a pick: rough paper or hide turned over, one soft flip per card, quick.

card.pick.name: card taken
card.pick.brief: A card taken: something with weight set down on wood. A decision made, not a menu click.

card.roll_blue.name: blue card
card.roll_blue.brief: A blue (magic) card among the dealt ones: a small glint, there if you listen for it.

card.roll_yellow.name: yellow card
card.roll_yellow.brief: A yellow (powerful) card: a brighter glint that makes you look for it.

card.roll_orange.name: orange card
card.roll_orange.brief: An orange (mythic) card: a struck metal ring that hangs in the air. Rare, so it should stop you.
